entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: the query needs instant %s, outside the range cerberus supports (%s to %s): ClickHouse cannot represent it exactly
entries.rationale: unreachable through the HTTP query endpoints: a request carries its own range, and every instant outside DateTime64(9) is answered in SQL (an empty read, a cut window, an isolated subquery, or a split range); only the bare Lower entry, which has no request instant, and a frame fit the range split retries can still reject
